name: Accessory Ossicle Syndrome of the Foot
tags: accessory ossicle syndrome of the foot
definition: Symptomatic accessory bone variant of the foot/ankle, such as os trigonum, os peroneum or other ossicles, producing pain through impingement, stress or tendon interaction.

investigations.principle: Radiographs identify ossicle; MRI/CT/ultrasound clarifies active inflammation, fracture or tendon involvement.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, physeal, occult injury, deformity or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Persistent mechanical symptoms may require injection or excision depending on the specific ossicle.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Pada/Asthi accessory structure phenotype may be documented descriptively.

patientEducation.summary: Symptomatic accessory bone variant of the foot/ankle, such as os trigonum, os peroneum or other ossicles, producing pain through impingement, stress or tendon interaction.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, open injury, severe deformity, rapidly progressive neurological symptoms, suspected infection or other listed red flags.
